integrity: The theorem is proved directly from Definition 2.1 of arXiv:2608.11169v1 and does not rely on the preprint's disputed Observation 2.2(iii). A finite exhaustive verifier is included only as a stress test.
scientific_limitations: Uniform capacities and upper bounds, zero lower bounds, and complete bipartite graphs only; no claim is made for arbitrary vector data or general multipartite graphs.
title: Exact uniform released packing on complete bipartite graphs
